name: ux-research
description: Plan and analyze UX research: interviews, surveys, usability tests, personas, JTBD, synthesis. Use when validating product/UX decisions with users.

name: wireframing-prototyping
description: Wireframe and prototype flows before building: low/high fidelity, user flows, clickable prototypes, feedback loops. Use early in feature design.

name: design-tokens
description: Define and pipeline design tokens (color/space/type/radius) across platforms (Style Dictionary). Use for a single source of truth for design values.

name: figma-to-code
description: Translate Figma designs to accurate, maintainable code: spacing, tokens, responsive, components. Use when implementing a design.

name: information-architecture
description: Structure content and navigation: hierarchy, taxonomy, labeling, findability, card sorting. Use when organizing a product/site's structure.
pitfalls: Structure mirroring org chart, not user tasks

name: usability-testing
description: Run usability tests: tasks, think-aloud, moderated/unmoderated, severity rating, iteration. Use to find real usability problems.
pitfalls: Testing too late to change anything

name: conversion-optimization
description: Improve conversion (CRO): funnels, friction, copy, social proof, experiments, hypotheses. Use to lift signup/checkout conversion.
pitfalls: Optimizing a vanity step, not the bottleneck

name: product-analytics
description: Instrument and analyze product usage (events, funnels, retention, cohorts) with Amplitude/Mixpanel/PostHog. Use to measure feature impact.

name: growth-experimentation
description: Run a growth experimentation program: ICE/RICE prioritization, hypotheses, guardrails, learning loops. Use to systematically drive growth.

name: saas-metrics
description: Model SaaS metrics: MRR/ARR, churn, LTV/CAC, cohorts, NRR, unit economics. Use for growth/finance analysis.

name: pricing-strategy
description: Design pricing/packaging: value metric, tiers, usage vs seat, willingness-to-pay, experiments. Use when setting or revising pricing.

name: analytics-instrumentation
description: Implement analytics tracking correctly: a tracking plan, typed events, a schema/CDP (Segment), QA. Use when adding product tracking.

name: crm-integration
description: Integrate CRMs (Salesforce/HubSpot): objects, webhooks, sync, dedup, rate limits. Use for CRM data flows.

name: customer-feedback
description: Collect and synthesize customer feedback: NPS/CSAT, support signals, feature requests, closing the loop. Use to turn feedback into roadmap.
pitfalls: No closing the loop with users

name: video-processing
description: Process video with FFmpeg: transcode, trim, scale, codecs, HLS/DASH, subtitles. Use for video pipelines. Detect ffmpeg first.
pitfalls: Re-encoding when a stream copy would do

name: audio-editing
description: Edit/process audio (FFmpeg/SoX/librosa): trim, normalize, denoise, format/rate conversion, loudness. Use for audio pipelines.

name: markdown-tooling
description: Author and lint Markdown/MDX: linting, formatting, frontmatter, embeds, docs pipelines. Use for docs content.

name: static-site-generators
description: Build sites with SSGs (Hugo/Eleventy/Jekyll/Docusaurus): content, templates, builds, deploy. Use for static sites/docs. Detect the SSG first.
pitfalls: No incremental build for big sites

name: cms-headless
description: Model and integrate headless CMS (Contentful/Sanity/Strapi/Payload): content models, references, previews, webhooks. Use for content-driven apps.
pitfalls: Tight coupling of content shape to UI

name: digital-asset-management
description: Manage media assets: storage, transforms/CDN, responsive images, metadata, rights. Use for image/video asset pipelines.
pitfalls: Serving originals instead of optimized variants

name: webrtc
description: Build realtime audio/video/data with WebRTC: signaling, ICE/STUN/TURN, peer connections, media, data channels. Use for P2P realtime media.

name: p2p-networking
description: Design peer-to-peer systems: discovery, NAT traversal, DHTs, gossip, libp2p. Use for decentralized/P2P apps.

name: cdn-edge
description: Optimize delivery via CDN/edge: caching, invalidation, edge functions, geo-routing, TLS. Use for global content delivery.

name: quic-http3
description: Understand and adopt QUIC/HTTP-3: streams, 0-RTT, head-of-line avoidance, migration, tradeoffs. Use for modern transport decisions.

name: network-observability
description: Observe networks: packet capture (tcpdump/Wireshark), flow logs, latency/loss, tracing. Use to diagnose network behavior.
pitfalls: Ignoring encryption limits on payload visibility

name: data-lakehouse
description: Build a lakehouse (Delta/Iceberg/Hudi): table formats, ACID on object storage, partitioning, time travel. Use for large analytical data platforms.

name: change-data-capture
description: Stream database changes (Debezium/CDC): log-based capture, ordering, schema changes, idempotency. Use for real-time data sync.

name: data-catalog
description: Build a data catalog and lineage (DataHub/OpenMetadata/Amundsen): discovery, ownership, lineage, glossary. Use for data governance/discoverability.

name: data-contracts
description: Define and enforce data contracts between producers and consumers: schemas, SLAs, versioning, checks in CI. Use to prevent breaking data changes.
pitfalls: Breaking schema changes with no version/notice

name: data-mesh
description: Apply data mesh: domain ownership, data-as-a-product, self-serve platform, federated governance. Use when scaling data org/architecture.
pitfalls: Mesh as a rebrand without ownership change
Governance too loose or too heavy
